The '''Aduba system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Bheriz sector/Legends|Bheriz sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained six [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including the habitable [[Aduba-3/Legends|Aduba-3]]. It was frequented by low profile [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]].
